scope: Three original resource packages; reusable offline deck and civil-time engines; no component-ID branches, scripts, microphone, paid model calls or remote user data.

components.name: 纠结扭蛋机
components.loop: Choose category, draw, reveal, exclude unwanted choice, draw remaining; reset only exclusions, never silently restore excluded choices.
components.visual: Cream and tangerine product-quality capsule machine; native text and generous buttons; reveal progress; original raster backdrop.

components.name: 答案之书
components.loop: Think of a small everyday question, open, reveal an original reflective prompt; close to ask again or draw another. Not prophecy or professional advice.
components.visual: Midnight indigo, warm ivory paper and restrained gold; large readable answer; original book backdrop.

components.name: 盼头列车
components.loop: View next departure, switch between weekday finish/weekend/custom date, edit date/time on device, explicitly save or cancel; celebrate arrived state without re-triggering each frame.
components.visual: Sage and sunlight miniature train landscape with clear ticket-like date/time; progress and arrival label driven by actual time.
components.clock: No battery-backed clock assumed. After full power loss show uncalibrated until PC provides current time; do not replay saved wall time as current.

acceptance: fast taps do not queue extra draws
exhausted choice pool stays exhausted until explicit reset
clock invalid after restart until synchronized
private saves excluded from community archive
native 640x480 layout and compiled image budget
public download matches tested package hash
